svg.text: How a T3 worker gets its environment and its "the brief is first-party" statement
Firstmate reads the T3 catalog for the chosen provider instance, then picks one channel per fact before anything is leased.
any other harness on upstream T3
Harnesses the one adapter table admits
claude, codex, grok, pi, muse, opencode, agy, cursor, and ACP-registry gemini, kimi, devin
Each row: T3 driver, default instance, effort option. Effort words map only onto catalog values of the same name (Grok refuses max).
Stop (t3_thread_interrupt stop: true) ends the worker's turn, its queue, and every task it delegated;
the close is proven only when the thread is archived with no run and no delegated thread still running.
Live proof on Grok and the other new rows is still to come; today's evidence is the portable suites against the fake T3.
